findings.mechanism: The focus forms qwl B001 and jcl B001/B002 carry spoken expression and an appointed state; the independent 19:35 occurrences كن and فيكون supply a saying followed by an actualized state, making the focus's speech and appointment meet as one effective operation.

findings.title: A contained legal reversal
findings.claim: The focus pairing of servant and Book can be heard through a contained legal reversal: a binding written obligation received in divine servitude separates the speaker from false filial ownership and places him under prophetic duty.
findings.mechanism: The exact servant and Book contract/determination facets meet in the focus phrase, while the supplied denial of divine offspring and command to worship provide the independent relational triggers that turn ownership language toward release from false claims and obligation to God.
findings.reader_payoff: The adjacent servant and Book words become a relation with legal pressure: the Book is received within service, and that service redirects what kind of ownership the identity can name.
findings.containment: The plain reading remains God's servant who was given the Book and made a prophet. The Book is not lexically a manumission deed, and the legal image is retained only as contextual wordplay around the supplied focus sequence.
